# x2c

> x2c extends C with dynamic values, collections, and compile-time code generation. Use the features you need; keep ordinary C where it already works. C headers, libraries, data layout, expressions, and native tools remain available. x2c compiles to C, and its compiler and runtime are written in x2c.

These pages describe x2c 0.16.0. x2c is experimental. Install it with `curl -fsSL https://x2c-lang.dev/install.sh | sh`.

[The x2c Book](https://x2c-lang.dev/docs/) contains every chapter.

## Single-file reference

- [x2c language reference](https://x2c-lang.dev/llms-full.txt): From C to x2c, Classes and System Macros, Programming Idioms, Language Reference, Command-Line Interface
